entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker and former Mardu dragon-seeker who has arrived in Tarkir's past and follows Yasova to learn more about the dragons and Ugin.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The Temur khan of the past, a dragon slayer with a glowing dragon-claw staff who has seen a vision of a dragonless Tarkir.

entities.name: Anchin
entities.description: Yasova's enormous sabertooth cat, very protective of her.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon whose voice guided Sarkhan and who is connected to the dragon tempests; in Tarkir's past he is alive and in danger.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who appeared to Yasova in a vision and promised to kill Ugin if she showed him where Ugin lies; Sarkhan realizes he is already on Tarkir.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: A Mardu khan Sarkhan knew in his own time who sought blood and vengeance.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A Jeskai khan Sarkhan knew in his own time, described as gentle and seeking knowledge.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: The clan of the mountains whose khan is Yasova in this era.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane, here in its dragon-filled past.

entities.name: Temur mountains
entities.description: The snowy mountain land Yasova rules, with bare steaming rock and high ridges.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A cavern from which Sarkhan took a hedron shard, where he heard Ugin's voice.

entities.name: Hedron shard
entities.description: A shard taken from the Eye of Ugin tied to Sarkhan's staff.

entities.name: Dragon tempests
entities.description: The storms that birth all dragons and are connected to Ugin's life.

entities.name: Yasova's mark
entities.description: Two sweeping curves Yasova gouges into stone at intervals, a trail charting the storms that Bolas asked for to find Ugin.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon, used by Yasova as a size comparison for the golden dragon she saw.

events.summary: Sarkhan, arrived in Tarkir's past, follows the woman with the dragon-claw staff up a mountain by her trail of marks.
events.quote: gouged two sweeping curves into it with the clawed staff she carried.

events.summary: Yasova's sabertooth tackles Sarkhan from behind and pins him in the snow.
events.quote: Something slammed into him from behind, huge and living and warm.

events.summary: Yasova questions Sarkhan, who says he follows the whispers of Ugin and thinks she may be his spirit guide.
events.quote: I seek the great dragon Ugin.

events.summary: Sarkhan gives his name; she greets him mockingly as 'khan of khans,' and he declines to claim dominion, bowing and flattering her as he once did Bolas.
events.quote: Yasova Dragonclaw of the Temur pays her respects to you, O khan of khans, and bids you welcome to her lands.

events.summary: Yasova threatens to kill Sarkhan unless he gives a reason to be spared; he kneels and offers to serve her.
events.quote: Give me a reason to spare you, Vol, or I'll kill you and be on my way.

events.summary: Sarkhan tells Yasova that in his homeland there are no dragons or dragon tempests, only bones, and that Ugin is long dead.
events.quote: Not in all of Tarkir," he said. "Only bones.

events.summary: Yasova confirms that she believes the dragons fall if Ugin dies, and Sarkhan realizes a storm guided him to her.
events.quote: If Ugin dies, the storms cease. The dragons fall.

events.summary: Yasova furiously rejects Sarkhan's claim that her people are better than the weak khans of his time, saying she has seen a paradise with no dragons.
events.quote: But I've seen the unwritten myself, seen a world with no dragons. And it was paradise.

events.summary: Yasova reveals that a great golden dragon appeared in her vision and asked her to chart the storms so that he could find and kill Ugin.
events.quote: He told me that if I showed him the way to the spirit dragon's lair…he would kill Ugin.

events.summary: Sarkhan realizes the dragon in her vision was Bolas, already on Tarkir in the past.
Sarkhan transforms into a dragon, breathes fire to push Yasova aside rather than fight, and flies off to protect Ugin.
events.quote: With a kick from his powerful legs, Sarkhan Vol launched himself into the sky.

relations.note: She is khan of the Temur Frontier.
relations.quote: Khan of the Temur Frontier, dragon slayer many times over, and lord of these lands.

relations.note: Her sabertooth companion, protective of her.
relations.quote: Anchin is very protective, and he won't be gentle with you a second time.

relations.note: He was Mardu in his own time.
relations.quote: He was Mardu, out of place and time.

relations.note: Bolas told Yasova he would kill Ugin.
He was Bolas's thrall in the past.
relations.quote: in his time as Bolas's thrall he had learned to speak it well.

relations.note: She threatens him, then they part in a clash after he learns of Bolas.
relations.quote: or I'll kill you and be on my way.

relations.note: He follows Ugin's whispers and flies to protect him.
